name: Palia – Zeki's Wondrous Machine
description: The prizes of Zeki's Wondrous Machine, by type.

items.name: Ancient Fish Plush
items.description: When you discover an ancient species, obviously you should create merchandise of it. Now everyone can enjoy their own fishy friend!

items.name: Ancient Kitsuu Plush
items.description: A firey [sic] friend that makes those cold nights even cozier. And with patented Zeki tech inside, it's almost as hot as the real thing!

items.name: Ancient Silverwing Plush
items.description: A cute plush based on the legendary Silverwing. Do you think they exist?

items.name: Elderberry Fun Guy Plush
items.description: This fluffy buddy is the latest and greatest from one of Zeki's galactic trading partners, decked out in chill colors and sparkling stars.

items.name: Free Realms: Chatty Plush
items.description: This little guy's busy making your world a better place!

items.name: Frogbert Plush
items.description: Your friends will turn green with envy when they see this adorable dude has hippity hopped into your life.

items.name: Fun Guy Plushie
items.description: A foraged friend to hug and hold. Don't let Jina see this charming, fun guy or she might get jealous!

items.name: Garden Variety Ceramic Bucket
items.description: This porcelain vessel lacks any distinguishing marks. You could use it for yardwork or, well, anything else.

items.name: Garden Variety Jug
items.description: There are many jugs like this in the world, but this one happens to be right here, right now.

items.name: Garden Variety Pickaxe
items.description: It's hard to say whether you'll need a pickaxe for gardening, but it's sure nice to have one just in case.

items.name: Garden Variety Shovel
items.description: There's nothing particularly noteworthy about this shovel, but it gets the job done.

items.name: Garden Variety Sprout Planter
items.description: This array of small pots lets seeds grow undisturbed. You wouldn't need one if there weren't so many chapaas.

items.name: Garden Variety Wooden Bucket
items.description: A moderately helpful gardening tool. If you lack a wheelbarrow, this bucket could probably do the trick.

items.name: Giant Honeybunch Plush
items.description: This adorable bee plush is too big to pick up, but you'll still be inseparable! Sleep in, bake homemade desserts, and enjoy a stay-cation together!

items.name: Green Cylinder
items.description: If you know, you know.

items.name: Honeybunch Armchair
items.description: Every hive needs a queen, and you can feel like royalty in this comfy bee-shaped armchair. Don't let the buzz go to your head.

items.name: Honeybunch Bed
items.description: Every night, bees return to the hive, and we return to our homes. It's always worth making time to go back to the things you love.

items.name: Honeybunch Bookshelf
items.description: This bookshelf is for people who are drawn to books as bees are drawn to nectar. But one nourishes the mind and the other, the body.

items.name: Lucky Zeki
items.description: Stylish Zeki miniature replica.

items.name: Me n' My Honeybunch Plush
items.description: Pick up this adorable bee plush, and the two of you will be inseparable. You`ll go to the park, the cafe, the beach... Wait, no, it`s not a date!

items.name: Ormuu Shack Ormuu Mug
items.description: A ceramic mug that was one of Ormuu Shack's limited-edition collectibles. Way better than Chapaa Hut.

items.name: Pink Maji Plush
items.description: Imported directly from some of Zeki's more galactic trading partners, this little plush of Maji sports a refreshing vibrant pink set of scales.

items.name: Ranch House Butterball
items.description: A plush based on Butterball, Nai'o's favorite prize-winning ormuu. She even dresses like him!

items.name: Ranch House Cottonbean
items.description: A plush based on Cottonbean, the shy ormuu. The overalls are hiding her bad fur day. How embarrassing!

items.name: Sage's Marble Singing Bowl
items.description: With this singing bowl, you can find inner peace by drowning your anxieties in a sound bath.

items.name: Sick Style Bahari Board
items.description: The design on the bottom of this Bahari Board looks like sick tracks from leaving everyone in the dust.

items.name: Spring Flutterfox Plush
items.description: May this delightful plush bring you all the happiness and energy you need to 'spring' into a new season!

items.name: Sweep the Bahari Board Wall Rack
items.description: You've conquered every halfpipe, ollie and kickstand. This rack of Bahari Boards is proof you've won every challenge that's come your way.

items.name: The Order Sernuk Plush
items.description: This plush sernuk can't pull a carriage, but it can be your faithful companion as you regale tales of the Order's mighty Watchers.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Bed
items.description: Welcome the beautiful sunrise from the comfort of this bed, which keeps you cool on warm nights and snug on cold ones.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Bookshelf
items.description: This stylish bookshelf is the perfect spot to store your books and other priceless knick-knacks.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Candelabra
items.description: An eye-catching candelabra with bulbs that are larger than life. If this piece doesn't make a statement, nothing else will.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Chandelier
items.description: A low-hanging chandelier that brings a touch of warmth to your home. Just watch out for those sharp corners.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Cloche
items.description: Many legends surround this mysterious rose that never wilts. Perhaps it is enchanted? Or blessed by the Dragon? Or maybe it's fake.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Clock
items.description: Reject modernity and embrace tradition with this ornate wall clock. It helps you keep track of time, and it's just downright cute.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Desk
items.description: A modest yet stylish desk carved out of smooth wood. Whether you set it up indoors or our, it's guaranteed to liven up your space.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Dining Table
items.description: From weeknight dinner to fine dining to poker game night, this practical table can do it all!

items.name: Valley Sunrise Grain Mill
items.description: Addicted to coffee? Or just like grinding stuff up? This kitchen-friendly grain mill is just the thing you need.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Hanging Lamp
items.description: Ever wanted to hang a bunch of onions from the ceiling? Now you can! But these ones glow and don't taste very good.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Knife Set
items.description: Nothing cozier than a comfy home for your knives. Hang it on the wall in your kitchen, or in other rooms to keep guest on their toes.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Lights
items.description: Whether you're scared of the dark or just want to brighten up your space, this dangling lamp does the trick!

items.name: Valley Sunrise Oval Table
items.description: A round wooden table with a thin table cloth draped across it. Ideal for early morning tea parties.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Side Table
items.description: Simple and quaint, this table makes a fashionable addition to any home.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Sink
items.description: Is it a sink? Is it a bathtub? Is it a storage cabinet? Who knows, but it can be whatever your heart desires.

items.name: Valley Sunrise Vase
items.description: A cute little vase with a cute little flower inside. Perfect for both indoor and outdoor spaces.

items.name: Winter Flutterfox Plush
items.description: Fires in the hearth while it snows outside, a warm blanket, and a mug of cocoa. But no cozy winter scene would be complete without this plush by your side!

items.name: Standard Smoke Bomb
items.description: Is there a bug bugging you? Use this smoke bomb to catch it!

items.name: Sneaky Smoke Bomb
items.description: Be very, very quiet... This smoke bomb that prevents you from alerting bugs.

items.name: Sticky Smoke Bomb
items.description: Whoa there! This smoke bomb slows down all insects in a given area.

items.name: Supreme Smoke Bomb
items.description: You never miss! This smoke bomb has a perfect catch rate.

items.name: Standard Arrow
items.description: A regular arrow that deals average damage.

items.name: Slowdown Arrow
items.description: An arrow that does average damage and slows creatures down.

items.name: Dispel Arrow
items.description: An arrow that deals high damage and disrupts the magical abilities of powerful creatures.

items.name: Blue Crackling Firework
items.description: A loud firework that fills the air with pops and explosions of blue lights.

items.name: Green Crackling Firework
items.description: A loud firework that fills the air with pops and explosions of green lights.

items.name: Orange Crackling Firework
items.description: A loud firework that fills the air with pops and explosions of orange lights.

items.name: Purple Crackling Firework
items.description: A loud firework that fills the air with pops and explosions of purple lights.

items.name: Red Crackling Firework
items.description: A loud firework that fills the air with pops and explosions of red lights.

items.name: White Crackling Firework
items.description: A loud firework that fills the air with pops and explosions of white lights.

items.name: Yellow Crackling Firework
items.description: A loud firework that fills the air with pops and explosions of yellow lights.

items.name: Glow Worm
items.description: A glowing flowing worm. Attach to your fishing rod to attract rare fish.

items.name: Worm
items.description: A regular earth worm. Attach to your fishing rod to attract different fish.

items.name: Repair Kit
items.description: Use these repair kits with the Repair Station to fix your tools.

items.name: Heat Root
items.description: Don't sweat it! Whether it's cooking or healing, spicy Heat Root will warm you up from the inside out.

items.name: Spice Sprouts
items.description: A spicy herb that can be used to add a zing to any dish! They apparently also have medicinal properties, and can help those with any coughs or sniffles.

items.name: Unopened Oyster
items.description: Open up this oyster! Even if you don't find a pearl, you can at least eat it.

items.name: Wild Garlic
items.description: Garlic is a delicious addition to any dish you cook! Or can be eaten raw to perfume one's breath.

items.name: Flow-Infused Wood
items.description: Flow-infused, sapwood lumber cut right from a tree.

items.name: Gold Bar
items.description: Thanks a bullion for this gold bar! Sells for a very high price.

items.name: Silver Bar
items.description: Silverware? Here! It's a silver bar! Sells for a high price.

items.name: Butter
items.description: Can't believe it's definitely butter? Well, nuthin's better!

items.name: Cooking Oil
items.description: If you need perfectly browned food, oil always be here for you.

items.name: Egg
items.description: Peki's come in 72 unique color- and pattern-breed combinations!

items.name: Milk
items.description: Ormuu milk from the Daiya family farm. Don't cry! Just get more if you spill it.

items.name: Vinegar
items.description: Vinegar's sharp taste gives foods a kick. Some people drink it straight.

items.name: Apple Tree Seed
items.description: Grows into an apple tree that can be harvested multiple times. Boosts amount harvested from other nearby crop types.

items.name: Blueberry Bush Seed
items.description: Grows into a blueberry bush that can be harvested multiple times. Boosts amount harvested from other nearby crop types.

items.name: Carrot Seed
items.description: Grows into one crop of carrots. Prevents weeds from growing on other nearby crop types.

items.name: Corn Seed
items.description: Grows into one crop of corn. Boosts amount harvested from other nearby crop types.

items.name: Cotton Seed
items.description: Grows into one crop of cotton. Boosts quality of other nearby crop types.

items.name: Onion Seed
items.description: Grows into one crop of onions. Prevents weeds from growing on other nearby crop types.

items.name: Potato Seed
items.description: Grows into one crop of potatoes. Helps keep other nearby crop types hydrated.

items.name: Rice Seed
items.description: Grows into one crop of rice. Boosts amount harvested from other nearby crop types.

items.name: Spicy Pepper Seed
items.description: Grows into a spicy pepper plant that can be harvested multiple times. Boosts quality of other nearby crop types.

items.name: Tomato Plant Seed
items.description: Grows into a tomato plant that can be harvested multiple times. Helps keep other nearby crop types hydrated.

items.name: Wheat Seed
items.description: Grows into one crop of wheat. Boosts amount harvested from other nearby crop types.
